login.title: Log in
login.guestNote: No account needed to look around — places, conditions and lessons are open to everyone.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Save your XP, lessons, streak and trips — on any phone.
signup.carry: Everything you did as a guest moves into this account, including your language.
signup.usernameHint: 3–20 letters, numbers, dot or underscore. Others see it on posts and leaderboards.
signup.usernameChecking: Checking if the name is free
signup.phoneHint: Only to reset your password with an SMS code. Never shown to anyone. You can add it later in your profile.
signup.terms: I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.

gate.title: Keep your progress

xp.title: Keep your XP
xp.body: Make a free account so your XP, lessons and streak don't get lost.

place.title: Save this place
place.body: Make a free account to save places and plan trips.

trip.title: Plan this trip
trip.body: Make a free account so your trip plans can alert your contact.

post.title: Join the community
post.body: Make a free account to post, join groups and climb leagues.

progress.title: Keep your progress
progress.body: Make a free account so your XP, lessons and streak don't get lost.

gate.perkTrips: Trip plans that alert your contact
gate.stays: Your progress stays on this phone until you sign up.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Enter your username. We'll text a 6-digit code to the recovery phone on your account.
forgot.noPhoneTitle: No recovery phone on the account?
forgot.noPhoneBody: Then the password can't be reset by code. Write to Irbis support from this screen and tell us your username.

reset.title: Enter the code
reset.body: If the account has a recovery phone, we sent a 6-digit code to it. It works for 5 minutes.
reset.resendIn: Didn't get it? Send again in %{time}
reset.resent: A new code is on its way.
reset.note: You'll be logged out on your other phones.

profile.guestBody: Make a free account to keep your XP, level up your panda and plan trips that alert your contact.
profile.signedOutToast: You're signed out. You can keep exploring as a guest.

phone.title: Recovery phone
phone.body: We'll text a 6-digit code to this number. It's only used to reset your password and is never shown to anyone.
phone.codeBody: We sent a 6-digit code to the number you entered. It works for 5 minutes.

session.ended: Your session has ended. You're browsing as a guest.

errors.usernameChars: Only letters, numbers, dot and underscore.
errors.usernameDot: A dot can't be first or last.
errors.usernameReserved: That name is reserved. Pick another one.
errors.passwordSameAsUsername: The password can't be your username.
errors.passwordWeak: That password is too easy to guess. Try another one.
errors.termsRequired: Please accept the Terms and Privacy Policy.
errors.locked: Too many tries. Try again in %{time}.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
errors.codeExpired: The code expired. Send a new one.
errors.codeAttempts: Too many wrong tries. Send a new code.
